why: The application repository is NOT writable with this session's credential (git push 403, POST /git/refs 403, POST /contents 403, POST /pulls 403, each verified twice on 2026-10-21). The product defect and the workflow integration are therefore delivered as apply-and-PR work in THIS repository, and the application defect is explicitly NOT claimed as fixed or merged.

patches.basis: patches/vendor/ghrdp-server.ps1 (exact bytes of the application revision named by basisAppSha; recorded in patches/vendor/.basis-sha)
patches.defect: /api/logon-status reads $Matches[1] AFTER a second regex has run. `-notmatch` rewrites $Matches even when it matches, and the user filter has no capture group, so every genuine LogonType-10 event was reported with logonType='' (and the source IP could be taken from a stale match).
patches.effect: The logon type and the source network address are captured into locals BEFORE the user filter runs, preserving user/source/time correlation.
patches.verification: scripts/test/live-mode-regressions.js re-applies the patch to the vendored basis with `git apply --check` + `git apply`, asserts the ordering property that constitutes the fix, and asserts the basis is genuinely defective (otherwise the test would prove nothing). The behavioural half - real Windows Security-log 4624 events - can only be observed on the Windows client job and is NOT claimed here.
patches.remainingPrerequisite: Someone with write access to dictationb1/supreme-lamp must apply this patch there and run the app's Windows verification.

patches.defect: The application publishes its authenticated URL into the JOB SUMMARY only. Nothing signals the lab, so no independent verification can start automatically while the ephemeral server is still alive.
patches.effect: Adds five steps to the `rdp` job between 'Service Readiness Check (Pre-Keepalive)' and 'Keep-alive 5h30': stage the lab's live runner at the pinned revision, build+publish the non-secret descriptor (with the credential envelope as a 1-day artifact), best-effort wake-up dispatch, and a bounded 25-minute wait for the verdict. No workflow_run trigger, so no dispatch cycle and no dependence on the run having finished.
patches.why_not_a_git_patch: main.yml is ~7.3k lines and shifts with every merged PR; a line-number diff would rot quickly and could apply into the wrong job. The applier is anchor-based and refuses to write unless both anchors occur exactly once, the result stays structurally sound, and the handoff is not already present.
patches.verification: scripts/test/live-mode-regressions.js applies the snippet to the vendored basis copy, checks the step order, the YAML structure, and that the published handoff contains no credential and never prints the token file.
patches.remainingPrerequisite: Applying this to the application repository requires write access there (denied for this session). It also needs ONE repository secret, LAB_RUN_RECORDS_TOKEN (a credential that can write the lab's `run-records` branch), for the queue-record publish and the optional wake-up dispatch; without it the lab's scheduled sweep still serves the run but the record is not written by the origin.
